description: Checks one web page: robots.txt rules for each AI crawler (search, user and training crawlers kept apart), what the server returns to each crawler's name compared with a normal browser and a plain automated request, noindex, and whether llms.txt is well formed. Returns one line per assistant (ok, blocked, or unknown when the site verifies real crawlers by IP), fixes, robots.txt lines to paste, and notes. Limited to 30 checks an hour per caller; results are cached for 10 minutes.

url.description: the website or page to check, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/page

name: check_ai_crawler_access
title: Can AI assistants read this page?
